q2_gaps: clause-level purpose adjunct "for + gerund" ("carry a candle for time-keeping"): the instruction set covers purpose infinitives (To / InOrderTo) and a noun's own "for V-ing" argument oblique, but not a for-gerund purpose adjunct on a verbal clause, so neither its attachment site (event vs object NP) nor its head is settled
review.notes: Bare-plural verbal generic as a rule at 0.9/0.9 with a dependent (sk_candle $x), "notched" kept as an unfused participial-adjective Member atom, and Theme for both carry and keep are all correct per the role tests. The purpose eventuality is one shared top-level constant sk_keep_1 (tenseless, so it claims no occurrence) rather than a per-keeper Skolem, which is defensible but weaker than the per-binding reading.
